title: Flow Slider Live Update
description: Flow should update while the slider is dragged and not wait for pointer release.
summary: Flow now re-evaluates during slider drag instead of waiting for pointer release. `DagHost::widget_drag_active` tracks active slider drags; `FlowHost::pointer_move_screen` calls `evaluate_internal` while dragging; `FlowSession::widgetDragActive` is exposed to React; `FlowCanvas` calls `evaluate()` on pointer move during slider drag so preview nodes and callbacks update live.
